nodes.label: Take Over Service Icon (256px)
nodes.description: Glossy 3D-style icon: a white house with blue roof, window and door, encircled by a red clockwise arrow on top and a blue arrow on the bottom, forming a transfer/cycle loop. Represents moving an existing mortgage to another lender. Part of the 256px service-icon set.

nodes.label: KPR Take Over (Mortgage Refinancing/Transfer) Service
nodes.rationale: Circular red/blue arrows around a house show a mortgage moving between banks (take over / balance transfer), which is what the icon filename says.
